legend.cpp_types: QML types implemented in C++ (from .qmltypes, i.e. QML_ELEMENT & friends)
legend.qml_types: QML types implemented in .qml files (from the module's qmldir)
legend.hdr/cpp: header and implementation file, relative to source_dir
legend.base: base type; `origin` says which module/library it comes from
legend.origin: `<module>` for a QML module, `qt` for a C++ Qt class, `local` for this module
legend.uses: types instantiated inside this file, grouped by origin module
legend.refs: types named in expressions but not instantiated (singletons, attached props, enums)
legend.used_by: files that instantiate, reference or inherit this type; empty means nothing uses it
legend.framework_types: non-project types instantiated or used as a file's base type, with counts: the Slint mapping worklist
legend.qobjects_not_in_qml: QObject subclasses in this module that QML never sees directly
